page_title: HOF 4-1 HAM | Hoffenheim v Hamburger SV 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Martin Petersen has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) after a cross from the side.
90+1' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) fails to score from the penalty kick. His shot goes just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' It's time for a substitution. Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) comes on in place of Vladimir Coufal.
88' Today's match ends for Nicolas Capaldo who will be replaced by Aboubaka Soumahoro (Hamburger).
84' 14:7 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
82' 4 - 1 Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Oliver Baumann with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 4:1.
80' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Grischa Promel will be replaced by Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim).
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tim Lemperle walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
78' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) replacing Ransford Konigsdorffer.
78' Substitution. Fabio Balde did his best and is replaced by Bakery Jatta (Hamburger).
77' Yellow card. Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
76' Hoffenheim keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
74' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.
72' 4 - 0 Goal Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim)! Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) was put through by Alexander Prass and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 4:0.
70' 8:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
67' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) replaces Jonas Meffert.
67' Substitution. Bazoumana Toure makes way for Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
67' Substitution. Andrej Kramaric makes his way off the pitch and Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) comes on as his replacement.
65' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
65' 3 - 0 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Bazoumana Toure and Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 3:0.
64' Ball possession – 58:42.
62' Hoffenheim players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
60' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
57' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) commits a rough challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for an infringement.
56' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

52' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
51' Hamburger SV are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
51' Martin Petersen blows for a foul after Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick to Hamburger SV.
50' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

50' A neat pass is well received by Miro Muheim (Hamburger), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the top left corner. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The ball goes out of play. Hamburger SV are awarded a corner kick.
48' Hamburger SV seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Oliver Baumann.
46' The second half has just started.
46' Merlin Polzin makes a half-time substitution. Rayan Philippe comes on in place of Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger).
45+3' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Neat passing move from Hoffenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.
43' Hamburger SV take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

42' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Oliver Baumann. The ball is out of play and Hamburger SV manage to earn a corner.
40' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Oliver Baumann.
38' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
35' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' The free kick from long range, taken by Hamburger SV, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

33' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
31' 2 - 0 Goal! Grischa Promel provides Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
30' The free kick from long range, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
27' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
25' The ball is cleared after Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It's a throw-in for Hoffenheim.
24' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
21' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
19' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and it's Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
17' The Hoffenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hamburger SV comes to nothing.
13' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Hamburger SV force a corner. They send men into the box.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.

8' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Wouter Burger sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
8' The foul by Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) was seen by Martin Petersen who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
7' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is prepared and dives to thwart him.
3' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will supervise the game today.
